parts:
Hi,

I have a problem that I've been struggling with for quite a while and I can't find a similar sample Shiny app that helps. I have a Shiny app where the user uploads a file and the app renders a number of charts, depending on the number of items read from file. Right beneath each chart, I insert a textInput field so that the user may comment a specific chart. This works fine on the server side. But I am not able to find a way to generate the UI for both the charts and their textInputs in a dynamic way. If I genereta a hard-coded number of plotOutput UI components thats is greater that the number actually needed - the page contains an empty space at the bottom.

Thanks in advance,
Anders

server.R
lapply(1:nrOfItems, function(i) {  
      output[[paste0("plot",i)]] <- renderPlot({
        ...
        hist(students$m16, breaks = bins, col = 'steelblue', border = 'white', main=maintitle,
          xlab="xlab", ylab="ylab")
        })
        
        output[[paste0("text",i)]] <- renderUI({ 
          textInput(paste("a", i, sep = ""), paste("Comment ", i, sep = ""), value = "")
        })
  })

ui.R
lapply(1:5, function(i) { # hard-coded 5, should be dynamic. How do I put the textInput beneath the chart?
   plotOutput(paste0('plot', i))
})
